title: Forward Security with Logarithmic Storage
summary: GGM1 supports secure deletion but incurs linear state growth under puncturing, while logarithmic worst-case storage with forward security remains unknown.

formal_statement.body: Can forward security for deleted epoch keys be achieved with $O(\log N)$ worst-case storage?

scope.domain: Forward-secure interval schemes for managing epoch keys in shared persistent data.
parameters: N: scale parameter for worst-case storage complexity
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether forward security for deleted epoch keys can be achieved with logarithmic worst-case storage.

citations.label: Group Key Progression: Strong Security for Shared Persistent Data

progress.summary: The paper states that logarithmic worst-case storage with forward security is not known and is therefore unsupported in GGM2. It contrasts this with GGM1, which supports secure deletion but incurs linear state growth under puncturing.
citation_labels: Matilda Backendal et al., Group Key Progression: Strong Security for Shared Persistent Data
